frequency_question: How often do regulatory decisions concerning capital buffer adjustments successfully meet precise threshold criteria when policy action is initiated?
membership_rule: Includes any formal policy announcement by the Federal Reserve regarding the countercyclical capital buffer; excludes general capital requirement changes or non-CCyB regulatory tweaks.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named instances covering the entirety of the CCyB operational history in the United States.
known_gaps: None, as the instrument has a short and fully documented operational history since inception.
skeleton: Formal regulatory policy announcements specifying numerical buffer thresholds divided by total scheduled review cycles where buffer changes were actively contemplated.
multiplier: 4 matching official announcements out of 4 relevant formal reviews where the instrument was evaluated.
validity_reason: The operational framework and announcement channels for the CCyB are institutionally stable and unlikely to undergo structural redefinition in the medium term.
